Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 9–14 quarter credits per university quarter is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Tuition is billed at $1,555 per 4.5-quarter-hour course; it is shown here as $345.56 per quarter hour, rounded to the cent (about 2 cents more per course). Accelerate courses ($3,045 per course) are not used.
  • The $100 Resource Kit is charged per course unless you opt out course by course (shown as $22.22 per quarter hour); opting out means buying course materials yourself.
  • Withdrawal, transcript, diploma and regalia charges, and state tuition-fund assessments, are not included.
  • Quarter loads of 2–3 courses (9–14 quarter hours) are a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 36 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Introduction to Business transfer to Strayer University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Business for BUS 100 Introduction to Business (4.5 quarter credits). The match does not come from Strayer, so ask Strayer to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Financial Accounting transfer to Strayer University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Financial Accounting for ACC 100 Accounting I (4.5 quarter credits). The match does not come from Strayer, so ask Strayer to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Visual Communications transfer to Strayer University?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Visual Communications for Electives (4.5 quarter credits). The match does not come from Strayer, so ask Strayer to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Strayer University’s Health Services Administration?

Strayer’s published limit for this 180-credit degree is 126 quarter credits from other sources. At least 54 quarter credits must be completed at Strayer. This plan proposes 36 quarter credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Strayer University?

In this plan, 144 quarter credits are taken at Strayer, including HSA 110 Navigating Healthcare with Innovation, HSA 115 Healthcare Communication and Terminology, HSA 225 Economics and Finance for Healthcare Leaders, HSA 235 Ethical Decision Making for Leaders, HSA 255 Introduction to Electronic Health Records and HSA 300 Health Services Organization Management and 19 more. Strayer requires at least 54 quarter credits at Strayer.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 31.5 quarter credits are open choices, such as Concentration (choose one) and Electives. You pick a course Strayer allows, then ask Strayer to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $54,023 to $54,449 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Strayer University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need Strayer’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school to confirm 4 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Pick a course for 7 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always Strayer’s decisions.
